hypothesis: Selecting only generated regional tracks, arcs and vias for exact DRC should preserve proposal legality while avoiding immutable source-only checks.

correctness.selected_via_bug_fixed: check_dynamic_copper_rules now checks selected vias against non-selected tracks and arcs, symmetric with selected-track/arc versus static-via checks.
correctness.unit_fixture: Dynamic DRC's proposal-relevant subset equals canonical whole-board DRC for both selected-track and selected-via/static-track cases while excluding unrelated static-static failures.

interpretation.reason: The exact selected-object formulation restored byte-identical Tier-0 output after fixing a real asymmetric-via API bug, but Tier-1's active realization tier remained 327 seconds. Bounded native DRC consumed only 14.3 seconds across 209 rejected candidates and about 25-36 ms on the critical candidates; it is not the 30-40 second per-candidate bottleneck.
interpretation.next_experiment: Measure candidate-local PH interpolation, XPBD, elastic/PNS shoves, trajectory polish, adaptive pair repair, quantization feedback, native fitting and DRC as separate phases on the first slow Tier-1 window.

research_basis.application: TritonRoute workers query spatially bounded fixed context, modify only objects in their standard box, perform DRC in private worker state, and commit only clean results.
OpenROAD detailed routing provides the maintained integration context for the worker-local search-and-commit architecture.
